cases.name: Rahilda, Feral Outlaw
cases.text: Whenever Rahilda deals combat damage to a player, exile a nonland card from their library at random. During any turn you attacked with a Wolf or Werewolf, you may cast that card and mana of any type can be spent to cast it.
